events.title: Character selector + options menu in
events.summary: Yep, as the summary says, the obvious features or character selection and options settings, are in!

events.title: Discord in up!
events.summary: So yeah,we have a discord group going on https://discord.gg/dmm3QcvNQjoin us if you are interesting in participating in the development of the game,you ll find we re very attentive to feedback!FireDev

events.title: Achievements are in!
events.summary: Achievements (at the initial ones) are in!Front stage takes off course, the ''I Killed Satan'' badge, with ''I killed Satan alone'', being a harder mountain to cross!

events.title: Fight with Satan
events.summary: And as you defeat the horde,and you think you ve made it, you exorcised the mansion,the earth shakes,and now, you have to fight Satan himself!When we said ''fight evil'' we meant it..A battle built, around the recent flying mechanics.

events.title: YOU CAN NOW FLY!
events.summary: Feel like a god, fly!Now, every time the Goblet Of Glory rewards you, you can fly!And when in ground, kill everyone inside your magic circle

events.title: Goblet of Glory update!
events.summary: What would The Boo Club be, without its Goblet of Glory, the powerful magical item which is the secret behind the success, of these, very very amateurish paranormal investigators, in fighting EVIL...Now, the Goblet rewards you for acting, and giving you super powers for while the effects lasts, if you get enough score. events.title: Item and camera fixes
events.summary: Now you can look like the enemies, and scare your friends (score: we need to find a way for this ''scaring of friends'' to be registered by the system dammit, it's not trivial how to do this, on it)Camera understands when its behind you, and makes you invisibleItem bug fixes Explanation of controls, look behind you!

events.title: Global score ranks are in!
events.summary: ok so after we got some initial scoring in, its time to add in global leaderboard ranksAnd in a very friendslop style, the more chaos you create (meaning, toying with your friends), the more score you get (although still, you have to find a way to still win the game, with requires collaboration)Also in friendslop style, you dont score as a team, but as greedy individuals heheNOTE: soon, another mode will be added, competition, where true collaboration will be rewarded. events.title: Score Mechanic In
events.summary: Score mechanic is in!But yeah, since we dont have leaderboards yet, nor more difficulty levels,the score rewards you more for tormenting your friends , than for being an amazing team.We hope this creates lots of laughter! (and yeah, higher difficulties, can be where the competitive nature of the game, really shines)

events.title: Teens become morons
events.summary: Feel like playing an kinda stupid amateur paranormal investigator, together with your friends?Come join our new crew (it's our old crew, but older, and alas, stupider). Life eeey?

events.title: From Kids to Teens
events.summary: 5 years pass in the blink of an eye (in game) and the Boo Club kids, become teens!+ lots of bug fixes+ smarter enemies (will chase you everywhere and longer)
